''See also: [[Grandmaster Avernus Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Grandmaster [[Avernus]] was a high-ranking leader who commanded significant [[Authority|authority]] and respect among her peers. She possessed long silver or gray hair and was known for maintaining a composed, rigid, and controlled demeanor. Her role involved making decisive leadership calls, managing [[Travelers]], and overseeing matters of importance to her cause. She was acquainted with [[Lysander Torannus|Overlord Lysander]] and had knowledge regarding the power dynamics of various figures, including the potential impact of the [[Incarnations]] on her father's influence. Despite her commanding presence, she eventually experienced a moment of vulnerability and loss of control before dying. It is noted that an [[Incarnation]] exists with the same name, a being characterized by mismatched wings, bronze feather-like hair, and talons, who was once described as a madwoman capable of mind control.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|This tall and refined woman possesses long, straight silver hair adorned with feathers. She has been seen wearing casual robes and carries an owl on one shoulder while a raven rests on the other.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Avernus]] displays a severe demeanor, yet she has shown an apologetic nature regarding the exclusion of [[Alin]] from decision-making. She is also capable of making predictions, such as her claim that [[Alin]] would free the [[Incarnations]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Avernus]] expressed regret regarding the exclusion of [[Alin]] from a decision-making process and once predicted that [[Alin]] would be the one to free the [[Incarnations]]. She also made claims regarding the location of [[Talos|Heir Talos]] and reported an incident involving [[Grandmaster Asphodel]]. Additionally, she has a prior acquaintance with [[Indirial]].}}

== The Crimson Vault ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|A tall and refined woman with straight silver hair adorned by feathers, Grandmaster [[Avernus]] is known for her severe appearance and a banner displaying four feathers on a brown-and-white field. While attending a meeting in casual robes with an owl and a raven perched upon her shoulders, she reported that a [[Valinhall Travelers|Valinhall Traveler]] had placed [[Grandmaster Asphodel]]'s head into a sack. During these proceedings, she expressed regret regarding [[Alin]] being excluded from the decision-making process. Despite her status, she was previously encountered by [[Indirial]] and eventually claimed that [[Talos|Heir Talos]] would be located within the [[Damascan camp]].}}
